doc: B12 editor-layout bounds pins (probe_b12_bounds guard, D-B12 entry condition). Per window size: expected descendant-component count, canonical dump byte count, and SHA256 of the canonical bounds-dump text (LF bytes). Captured 2026-10-19 headless (no peer, no paint) on the refactor/probes-u2u3-b12 tree. Regenerate only via the probe --write mode; any byte change here must move the same bytes the guard asserts.
